items.desc: Gain a Conqueror Emblem and a Rell.

items.desc:
Your team heals a percentage of their max Health every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:Seconds@ seconds.

When a champion dies, they retreat to the sidelines to cheer on your team. Your team's healing increases for each cheering champion.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:BaseHealthRegen@% %i:scaleHealth% base, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.1:HealthRegenPerMascot@% %i:scaleHealth% per cheering champion
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.2:BaseHealthRegen@% %i:scaleHealth% base, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mascot.2:HealthRegenPerMascot@% %i:scaleHealth% per cheering champion
items.name: Mascot

items.desc: Every @Duration@ seconds, revive the strongest ally that hasn't been revived yet at @HPPercent*100@% of their maximum Health.
items.name: Tome of Mending

items.desc:
After @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:FirstDelay@ seconds of combat, the Dragon strikes the board, dealing true damage and stunning all enemies. Allies gain Attack Speed for the rest of combat.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:TrueDamageHPRatio*100@% %i:scaleHealth% damage, Stuns for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:StunDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.1:AttackSpeedBuff*100@% %i:scaleAS%.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:TrueDamageHPRatio*100@% %i:scaleHealth% damage, Stuns for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:StunDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:AttackSpeedBuff*100@% %i:scaleAS%.
After an additional @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Dragonlord.2:SecondDelay@ seconds, the Dragon strikes again.
items.name: Dragonlord

items.desc:
Gain a spotlight hex.
Combat start: the unit standing in the spotlight gains bonus stats.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.1:DamagePercent*100@% %i:scaleDA% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.1:ManaPerSecond@ %i:scaleMana% per second.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:DamagePercent*100@% %i:scaleDA%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:ManaPerSecond@ %i:scaleMana% per second, and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Socialite.2:OmnivampPercent*100@% %i:scaleSV%. Gain another spotlight hex.
items.name: Socialite

items.desc: Kayle deals @DamageAmpPercent*100@% more damage. When she casts, she fires two waves.
items.name: Tome of Power

items.desc: Kayle deals @DamageAmpPercent*100@% more damage. Her attacks now hit in a @HexRadius@-hex radius around the target
items.name: Tome of Swiftness

items.desc:
Gain 2 Mountain hexes in the front row.
Combat start: units standing on a Mountain hex gain a Shield and permanent bonus Health.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:ShieldValue@ Shield, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.1:PermBonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.2:ShieldValue@ Shield, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Mountain.2:PermBonusHealth@ %i:scaleHealth%. The entire front row becomes Mountain hexes.
items.name: Mountain

items.desc:
Gain Shimmerscale items. These items give gold as well as combat power.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.1:MinUnits@)Gain Goldmancers Staff. At Stage @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.1:SecondItemStage@-@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.1:SecondItemRound@ gain Draven's Axe.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shimmerscale.2:MinUnits@)Gain Crown of Champions.
items.name: Shimmerscale

items.desc:
Your team's takedowns grant stacks of Conquest. After gaining enough Conquest, open War Chests full of loot!

Your team gains Attack Damage and Ability Power, increased by @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror:PercentIncreasePerChest*100@% for each War Chest opened.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:ADAPBase*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%; @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.1:StacksPerKill@x Conquest
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:ADAPBase*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%; @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror.2:StacksPerKill@x Conquest

War Chests Opened: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror_ChestsCompleted@
Current Stats: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Conqueror_CurrentADAP@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
items.name: Conqueror

items.desc:
Your team gain bonus Health, Attack Damage and Ability Power, which increases by 1% every time you spend gold on a Shop reroll.

After each combat, gain a 1 gold reroll for that round. Your first reroll each round grants @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk:FIRST_ROLL_BONUS@% bonus instead!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:MinUnits@ )@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:BONUS_HEALTH@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.1:BONUS_AD_AP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:MinUnits@ )@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:BONUS_HEALTH@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Punk.2:BONUS_AD_AP*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%

Current Bonus: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Punk_CurrentBonus@%
@TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Punk_CurrentHealthBonus@ %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_Punk_CurrentADBonus@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%
items.name: Punk

items.desc:
Summon a Hero named Kayle and evolve her as you level up!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver.1:MinUnits@) When you reach level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FirstArmoryLevel@, Kayle upgrades to 2-star. Pick a supportive effect.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver.2:MinUnits@) Kayle evolves again at levels @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:SecondArmoryLevel@, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:ThirdArmoryLevel@ and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FourStarUpgradeLevel@:
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:SecondArmoryLevel@: Pick a combat effect.
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:ThirdArmoryLevel@: Kayle upgrades to 3-star. Pick a combat effect.
Level @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Storyweaver:FourStarUpgradeLevel@: Kayle upgrades to 4-star.
items.name: Storyweaver

items.desc:
Gain a Glacial Mallet. Attacks from champions holding a mallet have a @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:ProcPercent*100@% chance to stun their target for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:StunDuration@ second and deal bonus magic damage.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:BonusDamage@ magic damage.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.2:BonusDamage@ magic damage. Gain another Glacial Mallet.
items.name: Glacial

items.desc:
Use the Pilot Selector to choose a Pilot. Combat start: the Pilot jumps into a Mech.

The Mech has the Traits and items of its Pilot, and gains a percent of the pilot's Attack Damage and max Health. When the Mech dies, the Pilot(s) are ejected with @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.1:EjectedPilotHealthPercent@% of their max Health.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.1:MinUnits@) Mini-Mech: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.1:MechCombinedADRatio*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.2:MinUnits@) Super-Mech: @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_MechPilot.2:MechCombinedADRatio*100@% %i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth%. The 2 nearest units to the Pilot also jump into the Mech.
items.name: Mech-Pilot

items.desc:
Your team gains @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro:BaseASPct@% %i:scaleAS% Attack Speed.

For each kill, your team creates an infernal cinder that you collect the next round. For every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro:NumCinders@ cinders you collect, your team gains @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro:ASPctPerNumCinders@% more %i:scaleAS%.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.1:NumCindersPerKill@ infernal cinder per enemy.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.2:NumCindersPerKill@ infernal cinders per enemy and execute enemies under @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Pyro.2:ExecutePct@% Health.

Cinders collected: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_PyroCindersCollected@
Team %i:scaleAS%: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_PyroAttackSpeed@%
items.name: Pyro

items.desc:
For each active trait, your team gains bonus Health and Damage Amp.
(Excludes unique and Anniversary Traits)

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.1:BonusHealth*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.1:BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.2:BonusHealth*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Jazz.2:BonusDamage*100@% %i:scaleDA%

Bonus Health: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT10_Trait_Jazz_TraitTracker_CurrentBonus@%
Bonus Damage Amp: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFT10_Trait_Jazz_TraitTracker_CurrentBonus_Damage@%
items.name: Jazz

items.desc:
Your team gains a Shield and Damage Amp for each adjacent ally.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:ShieldAmount@ Shield for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:ShieldDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.1:DamageAmp@% %i:scaleDA%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:ShieldAmount@ Shield for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:ShieldDuration@ seconds, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Rebel.2:DamageAmp@% %i:scaleDA%
items.name: Rebel

items.desc: Grant Kayle and adjacent allies in the same row @APAmt@ Ability Power at the start of combat.
items.name: Talisman of Might

items.desc: Grant Kayle and adjacent allies in the same row @ASAmt*100@% Attack Speed at the start of combat.
items.name: Talisman of Speed

items.desc:
Use this on a champion to make it the Pilot of the Mech.

[Cannot be used on champions in combat.]
[Unlimited uses]
items.name: Pilot Selector

items.desc:
At the times shown in the High Roller trait, roll a random Jinx mod:
- Rocket: Launch @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_NumRockets@ rockets at random enemies, dealing
@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.1:Spell1RocketADScalar*100@% Attack Damage + @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.1:Spell1RocketAPScalar*100@% Ability Power physical damage per rocket.
- Shield: Gain a @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_ShieldFlatAmount@ + @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_ShieldMaxHPPercentage@% max Health Shield for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.1:Spell2ShieldDuration@ seconds.
- Gold: Gain @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_GoldAmount@ gold.
items.name: Sevika's Jinxed Arm

items.desc:
Grant %i:scaleAP% @AbilityPowerPerGold@ Ability Power per %i:goldCoins% gold in your bank (up to %i:goldCoins% @AbilityPowerGoldMax@ gold) and a @OnKillProcChance*100@% chance to drop %i:goldCoins% @OnKillProcGold@ gold on enemy kill.

Gold generated this game: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_GoldGenerated@
items.name: Goldmancer's Staff

items.desc:
Every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.1:TickRate@ seconds your team grows, gaining bonus stats. This effect stacks up to @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.1:MaxStacks@ times.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.1:BonusResists@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.1:BonusADSP@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.2:BonusResists@ %i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Elderwood.2:BonusADSP@ %i:scaleAP%%i:scaleAD%
items.name: Elderwood

items.desc:
Attacks have a @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFTEvent5YR_Glacial_StunChance@% chance to stun enemies for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Glacial.1:StunDuration@ second and deal @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFTEvent5YR_Glacial_BonusDamage@ bonus magic damage.

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
items.name: Glacial Mallet

items.desc:
Gain Boss Knuckles. When the holder first drops below @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.1:HealthThreshold*100@% Health, they become The Boss and leave combat to start doing sit-ups. Each sit-up restores maximum Health and grants Attack Speed.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.1:HealPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.1:AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS%.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.2:HealPercent*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.2:AttackSpeedPercent*100@% %i:scaleAS%. If they reach full Health they return to combat Pumped Up: all of their attacks and abilities deal @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Boss.2:TrueDamagePercentage*100@% of damage as true damage.
items.name: The Boss

items.desc:
After each player combat, a random 1, 2 or 3 cost champion that usually fits your team is added to your bench for free.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Yordle.1:MinUnits@) Gain champions!
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Yordle.2:MinUnits@) If you have @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Yordle.2:NumOfThreeStarsNeeded@ or more 3 star champions, you instead gain a Yordle-Lord.
items.name: Yordle

items.desc:
Combat start: random enemies have their Health reduced.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.1:MinUnits@) Set @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.1:NumUnitsToReduce@ enemy's Health to @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.1:PercentHealth*100@% maximum Health.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.2:MinUnits@) Set @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.2:NumUnitsToReduce@ enemies' Health to @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Phantom.2:FlatHealth@.
items.name: Phantom

items.desc:
When an allied champion dies, a Doppelhellion (a one less star copy) equipped with a Red Buff will leap from the Hellion portal and join the fight!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hellion.1:MinUnits@) The first @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hellion.1:NumOfUnits@ champions
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hellion.2:MinUnits@) The first @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Hellion.2:NumOfUnits@ champions
items.name: Hellion

items.desc: Attacks grant Kayle @ASAmt*100@% stacking Attack Speed.
items.name: Scroll of Haste

items.desc: Kayle's Ability hits a wider area and deals @APAmt*100@% more damage.
items.name: Scroll of Force

items.desc: Kayle's damaging attacks and abilities @ResistPercent*100@% <TFTKeyword>Shred</TFTKeyword> and <TFTKeyword>Sunder</TFTKeyword> enemies hit for @Duration@ seconds.
items.name: Talisman of Aid

items.desc:
Your team's attacks and Abilities mark enemies. The mark stores a percentage of damage dealt to the enemy.

Marked enemies are struck by a cannonball after @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.1:BarrageInterval@ seconds, dealing the stored damage plus a flat value as physical damage.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.1:Damage@ + @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.1:DamagePercent@% damage dealt
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.2:Damage@ + @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.2:DamagePercent@% damage dealt. Every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Bilgewater.2:ShotsUntilTreasure@th cannonball is replaced with a treasure chest that drops gold!
items.name: Bilgewater

items.desc:
Your team heals for a percent of their Max Health every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:Duration@ seconds. If they are full Health, restore Mana instead.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:HealthPct*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, or @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.1:ManaPct*100@% %i:scaleMana%.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.2:HealthPct*100@% %i:scaleHealth%, and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Preserver.2:ManaPct*100@% %i:scaleMana%. Always get both.
items.name: Preserver

items.desc:
Gain a Sevika's Jinxed Arm!

Combat start: roll a random Jinx mod. Roll another one:
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.1:MinUnits@) after @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.1:RollingFrequency@ seconds.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.2:MinUnits@) every @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.2:RollingFrequency@ seconds. Mods are stronger, and the holder can now hit a Jinxed Jackpot!

Mods:
- Rocket: Launch rockets at random enemies.
- Shield: Gain a shield for @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller.1:Spell2ShieldDuration@ seconds.
- Coin: Gain gold.

Rockets Fired: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_RocketsFired@
Shields Gained: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_ShieldsGained@
Gold Gained: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_GoldGained@
Jackpots Hit: @TFTUnitProperty.trait:TFTEvent5YR_HighRoller_JackpotsHit@
items.name: High Roller

items.desc:
Once per combat at 60% Health, become The Boss and leave combat to start doing sit-ups. Each sit-up restores @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFTEvent5YR_Boss_HealPercent@% max Health and grants @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFTEvent5YR_Boss_AttackSpeedPercent@% Attack Speed. If all allies die, The Boss will immediately return to combat.

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
items.name: Boss Knuckles

items.desc:
After combat, the 3 champions closest to Nomsy feed her 1 Snax per star level, adding Health and Ability Power. Nomsy's star level increases every 25 Snax!

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Trainer.1:MinUnits@) Summon Nomsy!
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Trainer.2:MinUnits@) Nomsy's Ability deals @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Trainer.2:DamageInc*100@% bonus damage
items.name: Trainer

items.desc:
Combat start: select champions Ascend and gain @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.1:BonusHealthPercent*100@% maximum Health %i:scaleHealth% and @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.1:BonusASPercent*100@% Attack Speed %i:scaleAS%.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.1:MinUnits@) The strongest champion Ascends after @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.1:SecondsToAscend@ seconds.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.2:MinUnits@) The @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Shurima.2:NumUnitsToAscend@ strongest champions Ascend immediately.
items.name: Shurima

items.desc:
Nomsy needs to eat this many more Snax to level up!

[This does not count as an item.]
items.name: Delicious Snax

items.desc:
Gain %i:scaleAD% @AttackDamagePerGold@% Attack Damage per %i:goldCoins% gold in your bank (up to %i:goldCoins% @AttackDamageGoldLimit@ gold).

Attacks grant @StacksPerAttack@ stack, up to @CashoutStacks@ times. At full stacks, grant %i:goldCoins% @CashoutGold@ gold.

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
Gold generated this game: @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Item_GoldGenerated@
items.name: Draven's Axe

items.desc:
Combat start: select champions gain @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Imperial.1:DamageAmp*100@% %i:scaleDA%.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Imperial.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Imperial.1:NumOfUnits@ random champions.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Imperial.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Imperial.2:NumOfUnits@ random champions.
items.name: Imperial

items.desc:
The unit nearest to the center of your team is chosen as the Coven Leader, gaining bonus Ability Power.

Whenever your team casts an Ability, the Coven Leader gains Mana.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.1:AbilityPower@ %i:scaleAP%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.1:ManaToGive@ %i:scaleMana%
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.2:AbilityPower@ %i:scaleAP%, @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_Coven.2:ManaToGive@ %i:scaleMana%
items.name: Coven

items.desc:
Every @SecondsForEmpoweredAttack@ seconds, the next attack deals @AttackGoldMultiplier@x the amount of %i:goldCoins% gold in your bank in true damage.

[Unique - only 1 per champion]
This does no damage if you have 0 gold.
items.name: Crown Of Champions

items.desc:
Your team gains laser drones. When a unit attacks or is hit by an attack, their drone deals magic damage to the target (@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_LaserCorps.1:ICD@ second cooldown). Drones are reassigned to another ally on death.

(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_LaserCorps.1:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_LaserCorps.1:MagicDamage@ magic damage.
(@TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_LaserCorps.2:MinUnits@) @TFTTrait.TFTEvent5YR_LaserCorps.2:MagicDamage@ magic damage. All units gain an additional drone.
items.name: LaserCorps

items.desc:
Prevents the holder's first death. When they revive after 2 seconds, they shed all negative effects and gain @TFTUnitProperty.item:TFT_Event_SF_SoulCrownHealthRestore@ Health (double your Soul Power).

Contribute +1 to the last listed Trait. (Unique traits excluded.)

[Cannot be used on champions in combat.]
[Unlimited uses.]
items.name: Soul Crown

items.desc:
Contribute +1 to the last listed Trait. (Unique traits excluded.)

A new effect unlocks at the start of the tournament (4-1).

[Cannot be used on champions in combat.]
[Unlimited uses.]
items.name: Imperfect Soul Crown

items.desc: Combat start: Fire a sniper shot that instantly executes enemies.
items.name: Hextech Sniper Rifle

ability.desc: Shoot a tendril towards the current target, dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedPhysicalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to the first enemy hit and Stunning them for <scaleLevel>@StunDuration@</scaleLevel> seconds. It then spreads to @SpreadCount@ nearby enemies, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage and Stunning them for the same duration.

{{TFT_Keyword_Shred}}

Elise transforms into Spider Form for the rest of combat, reducing her Attack Range to 1 and replacing her ability with Venomous Bite, which she immediately casts.

Venomous Bite: Elise's next attack deals @ModifiedDamage@ bonus magic damage. If this kills her target she ascends, becoming untargetable before dropping near the lowest Health enemy and immediately casting Venomous Bite again.

ability.desc: Enchant the <scaleLevel>@NumTargets@</scaleLevel> closest allies or enemies. After landing, cast Flame Breath immediately.

Flame Breath: Breathe fire in a cone, dealing up to @ModifiedFlameBreathDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies hit. While breathing fire, is always enraged.

Each Combat: Neeko disguises herself as the nearest allied champion, adding their bonus Attack Damage and Attack Speed to her own and copying all other stats except Health. She then gains a shield for @ModifiedShieldBase@ plus @HealthRatio*100@% of her ally's Health.

When the shield breaks, she transforms into Neeko Form, reverts back to her own stats, and casts Pop Blossom, dealing @ModifiedMagicDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for @StunDuration@ seconds. Neeko then casts Pop Blossom each time she reaches maximum mana.

Allies within range will prioritize attacking Blitzcrank's target.

Lissandra encases a random enemy in ice, stunning them for @EnemyStunDuration@ seconds and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to all enemies @MaxHexRange@ hexes around the target.

Fiora reveals four Vitals on an enemy champion before becoming untargetable as she strikes each once in rapid succession.

Each strike deals @PercentAD*100@% of her Attack Damage as physical damage (Total: @TotalDamage@), @ModifiedBonusDamage@ bonus true damage, and heals her for @PercentHealing*100@% of the total damage dealt.

Active: Gangplank shoots his barrels, causing them all to explode, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to nearby enemies and applying on-hit effects.

After her second takedown, Jinx swaps to her rocket launcher, causing her attacks to deal @ModifiedDamage@ bonus magic damage to all enemies in a small area around her target.

Blue: Restores @BlueCardManaRestore@ mana to all allies adjacent to Twisted Fate.
Red: Deals @ModifiedRedCardDamage@ to all enemies adjacent to the target.
Gold: Stuns the target for @GoldCardStunDuration@ seconds.

When the bomb detonates, it deals @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage to all nearby enemies, plus @PercentDamageIncrease@ for each attack, up to a maximum of @ModifiedMaxDamage@.

While in cat form, Nidalee's range is reduced to 1 hex and she gains @ADinCougar@ bonus Attack Damage.
ability.name: Primal Surge

Rek'Sai burrows, becoming untargetable for @BurrowDuration@ second and healing for @ModifiedHeal@ health.

She emerges at her target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ magic damage and knocking them up for @KnockupDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Burrow

Erupt the entire battlefield in flames, permanently Burning and Wounding all enemies and dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to each of them over @DamageDuration@ seconds.

Annie's max Mana is reduced by @ManaCostReduction@ for the rest of combat. Subsquent casts launch a fireball at target that deals @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage.

{{TFT_Keyword_Burn}}
{{TFT_Keyword_Wound}}
ability.name: Enraged Inferno

ability.desc:
Summon an elemental from behind the farthest enemy. It 20% Chills enemies hit for @SlowDuration@ seconds and deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them.

When it arrives, headbutt it and redirect it toward another distant enemy, dealing @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead.

{{TFT_Keyword_Chill}}
ability.name: Call of the Forge

ability.desc:
Dash, then create a @HexRadius@-hex radius zone for @Duration@ seconds that shields allies within for @ModifiedShieldAmount@ (%i:scaleAP%) health for the zone's duration. While active, double current Attack Speed and on attack, fire a secondary arrow at a nearby enemy that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage.

When the zone ends, heal all allies for @ModifiedHealPercentage@ (%i:scaleAP%) of damage dealt while it was up and dash away.
ability.name: Lamb's Respite

ability.desc:
Passive: After witnessing 3 attacks from Azir, Sand Soldiers deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to their target.

Active: Summon a Sand Soldier near target and command them to strike. If @MaxSummons@ Soldiers are already out, they all immediately deal @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead.
ability.name: Arise!

ability.desc:
Throw a Time Bomb on the nearest enemy without one. Time Bombs deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage each second. When the target dies, they explode, dealing @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage in a 1 hex radius and grant Zilean @ManaOnKill@ mana.

If a Time Bomb is on an enemy for @MaxDurationBeforeKill@ seconds and Zilean is alive, the enemy instantly dies.
ability.name: Visions of the End

ability.desc: Teleport into a large cluster of enemies within @SlotSearchRadius@ hexes and Stun them for @FearDuration@ seconds. Begin losing @ManaLossPerSecond@ mana per second. While casting, deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage per second to all enemies within a @AOERadius@ hex radius. The closest @NearestEnemies@ enemies take <TFTBonus>@NearestBonusDamage*100@%</TFTBonus> more damage.
ability.name: Crowstorm

ability.desc:
Dragon's Descent: Transform into a dragon, gaining @TransformHealth@ max Health. Briefly gain @TransformDurability*100@% Durability and dive-bomb into the largest group of enemies, dealing @ModifiedDivebombDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage in a 3 hex circle.

Flame Breath: Breath fire in a cone for @SpellDuration@ seconds, dealing @ModifiedFireDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage each second to enemies hit.
ability.name: Dragon's Descent / Flame Breath

ability.desc:
Passive: Every @NumAttacks@rd attack deals @BonusPassiveDamage@ (%i:scaleMR%) magic damage in a circle around the target.

Active: Dash into the largest group of units and inspire all allies within 2 hexes, granting them @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Then crash down, dealing @ModifiedActiveDamage@ (%i:scaleMR%%i:scaleArmor%) bonus magic damage to all enemies with 2 hexes.
ability.name: Inspirational Might

ability.desc:
Devour target for @BellyDuration@ seconds, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and making them immune to other sources of damage. During this time, gain @DamageReduction*100@% Durability. If they are immune to crowd control, deal @ReducedModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage instead.

If they die while devoured, spit out a random component they were holding or the unit's cost in gold. Otherwise, spit them towards the farthest enemy, briefly Stunning targets on impact.
ability.name: Devour

ability.desc:
Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Strike in a cone and a line. Enemies hit take @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage and are 30% Chilled for @ChillDuration@ seconds. If they are already Chilled, Stun them for @StunDuration@ second.

{{TFT_Keyword_Chill}}
ability.name: Winter's Wrath

ability.desc: Grab target and slam them forward, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> + <magicDamage>@ModifiedPercentOfTargetMaxHealth@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> of their max Health as magic damage to them. All other enemies within @AoERadius@ hexes take <TFTBonus>@PercentAoEDamage*100@%</TFTBonus> of the total damage.
ability.name: The Show Stopper

ability.desc:
Passive: Immune to crowd control effects. Attacks briefly knock up the target and deal @PassivePercentAoE*100@% damage in a 1 hex radius around them.

Active: Slam the ground, dealing @ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to ALL enemies, reduced by @EffectReductionPerHex*100@% for each hex from the center (down to @EffectReductionMinimum*100@%.) If this is the first time they've been hit by Seismic Slam this combat, knock them up for up to @StunDuration@ seconds. @NumRocks@ rocks fall around the battlefield, each dealing @ModifiedRockDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to enemies hit.
ability.name: Seismic Slam

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks fire a barrage of @NumBullets@ bullets.

Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleHealth%) Shield and begin consuming @ManaCostPerSecond@ mana per second. Each second while casting, fire a laser that deals @ModifiedLaserDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage, reduced by @LaserFalloffPerTarget*100@% per enemy hit up to @LaserFalloffCap*100@%. Additionally, launch @ModifiedMissilesPerSecond@ (%i:scaleAS%) missiles split between @RocketNumClosestEnemies@ nearby enemies that each deal @ModifiedMissileDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.
ability.name: Hextech Arsenal

ability.desc:
Passive: On takedown, gain @AttackSpeedOnTakedown*100@% Attack Speed that decays over @ASDuration@ seconds.

Active: Deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage in a 2 hex radius and transform for the rest of combat.

While transformed, gain @ModifiedAttackSpeed@ (%i:scaleAP%) Attack Speed, @PercentMaxHealthGain*100@% max Health, and increased Move Speed. Attacks deal @TrueDamageBase@ bonus true damage, increased by @TrueDamagePerStack@ for each time the same enemy is hit.
ability.name: Endless Banquet

ability.desc:
Passive: Run around the battlefield, leaving a poison trail that lingers for @PoisonCloudDuration@ seconds. Poison trails deal @ModifiedDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage per second to enemies within. Gain @ModifiedManaPerSec@ (%i:scaleAS%) Mana each second.

Active: For @SpellDuration@ seconds, gain increased Move Speed, restore @ModifiedHealPerSecond@ (%i:scaleAP%) Health each second, and gain @ArmorMR@ Armor and Magic Resistance.
ability.name: Poison Trail

ability.desc:
Passive: For every @StardustPerDamage@ ability damage dealt to enemies in player combat, gain Stardust. Stardust makes The Skies Descend more powerful. (Current Stardust: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_AurelionSol_Stardust@)

Active: Crash a star on target, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage in a @InitialHexRadius@ hex radius.

@StardustThreshold5@: Shockwave increases to @Threshold5Radius@ radius.@StardustThreshold5@: Shockwave increases to @Threshold5Radius@ radius.
@StardustThreshold6@: The star crash deals @Threshold6BonusDamagePercent*100@% bonus true damage.@StardustThreshold6@: The star crash deals @Threshold6BonusDamagePercent*100@% bonus true damage.

ability.name: The Skies Descend

ability.desc:
Passive: Gain @IncreasedAPRatio*100@% more Ability Power from all sources.

Active: Call down a storm of @NumMeteors@ meteors across the battlefield that deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage each. They can innately critically strike. For each one that kills an enemy, permanently gain @APPerKill@ Ability Power. (Permanent Ability Power: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_Unit_VeigarBonusAP@% %i:scaleAP%)
ability.name: Dark Storm

ability.desc:
Passive: Immune to Crowd Control effects. Attacks deal damage in a line on target. If no enemies are in range, dash to the next one and knock up adjacent enemies on arrival.

While in the Void Rift, erupt a tentacle below a random enemy every @TentacleRefreshSeconds@ seconds that knocks them up for @TentacleKnockupDuration@ seconds.

Active: Slam and erect spikes in a 2 hex circle, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to enemies hit. Then over 3 seconds, spit @NumAcidToShoot@ globs of acid that deal @ModifiedAcidDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage.
ability.name: Wrath of the Void

ability.desc:
Restore @TotalHealing@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) Health and spin, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to adjacent enemies and applying a stack of Hemorrhage that deals @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage each second for @BleedDuration@ seconds.

If an enemy with Hemorrhage drops below @ExecutePercentPerHemorrhage*100@% Health, slam on them, instantly killing them. (Each stack increases the execute threshold by @SecondaryExecutePercentPerHemorrhage*100@%)
ability.name: Decimate

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks alternate between dealing @ModifiedBasicAttackADDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) bonus physical damage and @ModifiedBasicAttackAPDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage.

Active: Strike through the most enemies possible within @TooltipHexRange@ hexes, knocking them up for @KnockupDuration@ seconds and dealing @ModifiedPerTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage and @ModifiedPerTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Yone then splits @ModifiedStrikeDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage and @ModifiedStrikeDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage among all enemies hit.

Blade Brothers: When you field Yasuo and Yone, Yasuo assists Yone's casts.Blade Brothers: When Yone casts, your strongest Yasuo blinks to each target, dealing bonus physical damage.
ability.name: Kin of the Stained Blade

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@AttackSpeed*100@%</TFTBonus> Attack Speed, <TFTBonus>@Omnivamp*100@%</TFTBonus> Omnivamp, increased Move Speed, and deal <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> bonus physical damage on attack for the rest of combat. While this effect is active, takedowns grant Warwick, Jinx, and Vi <TFTBonus>@ModifiedTakedownAttackSpeed@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Attack Speed for @AllyBuffDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Eternal Hunger

ability.desc: Become briefly untargetable, then jump to the farthest enemy within @HexRange@ hexes, avoiding Tanks and Fighters, and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies. For the next @NumAttacks@ attacks, gain <TFTBonus>@ASBoost*100@%</TFTBonus> Attack Speed and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedAttackDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> bonus magic damage on hit.
ability.name: Playful Trickster

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds and deal <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to target. After a delay, briefly knock them up and deal the damage again. Bucklers fly out from the target, granting @NumShieldedAllies@ nearby allies <TFTBonus>@AllyShieldAmount*100@%</TFTBonus> of the Shield gained.
ability.name: Hammer Shock

ability.desc: Gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Shield and summon storm of lightning. @NumBolts@ waves of bolts hit enemies within, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage over @Duration@ seconds. The first @MaxStuns@ targets to be struck by @BoltLimit@ bolts are Stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds. Multiple Stuns on the same enemy have @DuplicateStunReduction*100@% effectiveness.
ability.name: Slicing Maelstrom

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks are replaced with a bomb that bounces @BABounceNumber@ time, dealing @ModifiedBasicAttackDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to units hit.

Active: Throw an enormous bomb at the largest @BombAOERange@-hex group of enemies that explodes on impact, dealing between @ModifiedMinDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) and @ModifiedMaxDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies hit based on their distance from the epicenter.
ability.name: Mega Inferno Bomb

ability.desc:
On cast, cycle through one of the following abilities:

Slash in a line, dealing @FirstCastModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to enemies hit and 20% Sundering them for @SunderDuration@ seconds.

Swipe in a cone, dealing @SecondCastModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage to enemies hit and knocking them up for @SecondCastStunDuration@ second.

Slam on target, dealing @ThirdCastModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%) physical damage in a 1 hex circle. Targets below @ThirdCastExecute*100@% max Health are executed.
ability.name: The Darkin Blade

ability.desc:
Bite the target and mark them, dealing @ModifiedBiteDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleHealth%) physical damage, increased by @PercentDamageIncrease*100@% if they are already marked. After casting @CastsToTransform@ times, leap to a nearby hex, activating Stormbringer and dealing @ModifiedSlamDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to enemies within a two hex radius.

Stormbringer: Gain @StormbringerBonusHealth@ Health and @StormbringerAS*100@% Attack Speed. Every @BoltCadence@ seconds, summon a lightning bolt on a nearby enemy, dealing @ModifiedBoltDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Takedowns summon a bolt on fallen enemies.
ability.name: The Relentless Storm

ability.desc: For the next 4 attacks, set Attack Speed to <TFTBonus>@SpellFixedAS@</TFTBonus>, gain infinite range and replace attacks with a cannon shot. Cannon shots deal <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage. The 4th shot deals <TFTBonus>@FourthShotDamageMult*100@%</TFTBonus> more damage.
ability.name: Curtain Call

ability.desc: Each item equipped to the invention will determine what it does when it fires.
ability.name: Piltover Customs Special

ability.desc: Placeholder Tooltip
ability.name: Placeholder Name

ability.desc: Does not move or attack. This unit dies when the Emperor dies.
ability.name: Stand Guard

ability.desc:
Cast one of three spells:

Cataclysm: Leap on a nearby enemy. Deal @ModifiedJarvanDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to all enemies within 2 hexes and Stun them for @JarvanStunDuration@ seconds.

Demacian Justice: Deal @ModifiedGarenDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to target. If they are below @GarenExecute*100@% max Health, execute them.

Final Spark: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Deal @ModifiedLuxDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to all enemies in a line.
ability.name: Stolen Might

ability.desc:
Release a runic blast, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. It splits in two, dealing @SplitPercentDamage*100@% of the damage to the closest two enemies. Each secondary blast splits an additional time.

Bilgewater: Blasts explode on impact, dealing @BilgewaterExplosionPercent*100@% of the damage as physical damage to adjacent enemies.
Demacia: Execute targets below @ModifiedDemaciaExecuteThreshold@ (%i:scaleArmor%%i:scaleMR%) Health.
Freljord: Chill targets for @FreljordChillDuration@ seconds and deal @ModifiedFreljordTrueDamage@ (%i:scaleHealth%) bonus true damage.
Ionia: Blasts split an additional time, dealing @IoniaDamageReduction*100@% damage.
Ixtal: Gain a random Region's effect on combat start and every @ExplorerProcRate@ seconds.
Noxus: Blasts now pierce targets, dealing @NoxusPercentDamageReduction*100@% reduced damage per enemy hit.
Piltover: Every third cast is Overcharged, dealing @PiltoverOverchargePercentBonus*100@% more damage.
Shadow Isles: Increase blast damage by @ModifiedShadowIslesBonusDamage@ (%i:scaleSouls%).
Shurima: Knock up enemies for @ShurimaKnockUpDuration@ seconds, with a chance to dredge up Gold or Treasures.
Targon: Heal the lowest Health ally for @TargonHealPercent*100@% of the damage dealt.
Void: Ignore @VoidResistIgnore*100@% of enemies' Armor and Magic Resistance.
Yordle: Shrink targets hit, lowering their damage by @YordleDamageReductionPercent*100@% percent for @YordleDamageReductionDuration@ seconds.
Zaun: Poison targets, dealing @ZaunDamage@ magic damage @ModifiedZaunTicks@ (%i:scaleAS%) times over @ZaunPoisonDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Runic Overload

ability.desc:
Jump on an adjacent enemy with the lowest health, then deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them and @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to adjacent enemies. If any die, cast again, dealing @DamageReductionPerCast*100@% damage.

Tanks take @TankDamageMult*100@% more damage from this ability and Fighters take @FighterDamageMult*100@% more.
ability.name: Relentless Pounce

ability.desc:
Become enraged for @Duration@ seconds. While enraged, gain @ModifiedDurability@ (%i:scaleAP%) Durability and attacks are replaced with a strike that deals @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage. Ignore @ArmorIgnore*100@% of Armor against Chilled enemies.

Bloodsworn Bond: When you field Ashe and Tryndamere, your strongest copies permanently increase their power on kill.Bloodsworn Bond: Gain increased Move Speed. Gain @AttackSpeed_MustMatchTFT16_Tryndamere_PassiveAS*100@% Attack Damage, permanently increased by @TryndASBoostFromAshe*100@% whenever Ashe or Tryndamere score a kill. (Current Bonus: @TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_Tryndamere_PassiveAS*100@%)

{{TFT_Keyword_Chill}}
ability.name: Undying Rage

ability.desc: Gain <scaleHealth>@BonusHealth@</scaleHealth> max Health and grow larger. Slam in a @HexRange@ Hex circle on the target, dealing <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleHealth%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies hit. For @Duration@ seconds, gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedDurability@ (%i:scaleAP%)</TFTBonus> Durability + <TFTBonus>@DurabilityPerEnemy*100@%</TFTBonus> for each enemy targeting this unit.
ability.name: Warp Armor

ability.desc:
Passive: While gaining Mana, throw out @NumOfOrbs@ radiant orbs that orbit around target. They deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage in a 1 hex radius and drain @ManaDrainPerSecond@ Mana from enemies hit each second. After draining @ManaAmount@ mana, gain a random Radiant Item. (@TFTUnitProperty.:TFT16_Mel_ManaSpent@/@ManaAmount@)

Active: Detonate orbs on target, causing a @FinalExplosionHexRadius@ hex radius explosion that deals @ModifiedTargetDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them and @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) damage to all other enemies hit.
ability.name: Radiant Eclipse

ability.desc:
Passive: Attacks fire in a cone on target, dealing @AttackDamageMultiplier*100@% damage to other enemies hit.

Active: Fire an explosive shell at target, dealing @TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage split among enemies in a 1 hex circle.

Partners in Crime: When you field Graves and Twisted Fate, both gain bonuses.
ability.name: Collateral Damage

ability.desc:
Passive: All allies gain @ArmorForAllies@ Armor.

Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield for @ShieldDuration@ seconds. Impale up to three nearby enemies in a line, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleArmor%) physical damage and Stunning them for @ImpaleDuration@ seconds.
ability.name: Impale

ability.desc:
Passive: Ability damage from your strongest Leona and strongest Diana marks enemies as Moonlit, reducing their damage by @MoonlightDamageReduction*100@%.

Active: Gain @ModifiedShield@ (%i:scaleAP%) Shield. Unleash a bolt of lunar energy at the farthest non-Moonlit enemy within @HexLimit@ hexes, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Then, dash to all Moonlit enemies, dealing @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them.
ability.name: Lunar Rush

ability.desc: Dash away from all enemies, then fire <scaleLevel>@NumMissiles@</scaleLevel> missiles split across the @NumTargets@ nearest enemies. Each missile deals <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage.
ability.name: Icathian Rain

ability.desc: Dash to the lowest Health enemy within @DashRange@ hexes, dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDashDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%)</physicalDamage> physical damage to all enemies in the path. Then slash @BaseSlashTimes@ times, each dealing <physicalDamage>@ModifiedSlashDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage. Subsquent casts increase the number of slashes by @NumIncreasePerCastBreakpoint@.
ability.name: Slice and Dice

ability.desc: Steal <trueDamage>@ModifiedHealthSteal@ (%i:scaleAP%)</trueDamage> Health split between the <scaleLevel>@NumEnemies@</scaleLevel> nearest enemies. For @Duration@ seconds, gain <TFTBonus>@Resists@</TFTBonus> Armor and Magic Resist and deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamagePerSecond@ (%i:scaleHealth%)</magicDamage> magic damage to adjacent enemies each second.
ability.name: Fury of the Sands

ability.desc: Launch @NumberOfBlasts@ arcane blasts randomly split between the closest @SpellRangeInEnemies@ enemies that each deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.
ability.name: Eye of the Ascendant

ability.desc:
Passive: Each second, deal @ModifiedHealthDrain@ (%i:scaleAP%%i:scaleSouls%) magic damage to all enemies within 2 hexes. Heal for @HealthDrainPercentHeal*100@% of the damage dealt by this effect.

Active: Create a prison of walls in a 2 hex radius that lasts @TheBoxDuration@ seconds. While active, the Passive's damage is doubled. When an enemy touches a wall, they take @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. If there are less than @MinEnemiesInTheBox@ enemies inside The Box at any time, drag an enemy in.
ability.name: The Box

ability.desc:
Passive: Gain @PassiveOmnivamp*100@% Omnivamp.

Active: Dash around the target and snip @ModifiedCastSnipTimes@ (%i:scaleSouls%) times, dealing @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to them and @ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) damage to all other enemies in a cone.
ability.name: Snip Snip!

ability.desc: Summon <TFTBonus>@TotalNumberOfSpears@ (%i:scaleSouls%)</TFTBonus> spears split among the @NumberOfEnemies@ nearest enemies. After a brief delay, they each impale their target, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage and reducing Armor by <TFTBonus>@ArmorReduction@</TFTBonus>.
ability.name: Endless Rend

ability.desc: Summon @NumTargets@ dashing mirror images that strike the target and up to @ModifiedNumTargets@ other nearby enemies. The target takes <magicDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage and is Stunned for @StunDuration@ second, while other units hit take <magicDamage>@ModifiedSecondaryDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage.
ability.name: Distortions

ability.desc:
Passive: Gain @ModifiedAttackSpeed@% (%i:scaleSouls%) Attack Speed.

Active: Deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%) physical damage to target. For the rest of combat, Viego's attacks deal @ModifiedStackingDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus stacking magic damage.
ability.name: Blade of the Ruined King

ability.desc:
Create a @HexRange@ hex zone around the target that lasts @Duration@ seconds. The next 3 attacks deal @BonusMagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) bonus magic damage.

When the zone ends, it deals @MagicDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage + @DamageRatio*100@% of the target's damage taken during the duration to all enemies in the zone.
ability.name: Parallel Convergence

ability.desc: Launch @NumMissilesBase@ Meeps at nearby enemies that deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage. Add an additional Meep for each 3-star unit on your board. (Total Meeps: @TFT16_Bard_Num3Stars@)
ability.name: Traveler's Call

ability.desc: Tumble to a nearby hex, then fire a bolt at target that deals <trueDamage>@TotalDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</trueDamage> true damage.
ability.name: Tumble

ability.desc: <spellPassive>Passive:</spellPassive> Gain <TFTBonus>@Omnivamp*100@%</TFTBonus> Omnivamp. Every @NumAttacksToCleave@ attacks, deal <magicDamage>@ModifiedCleaveDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%)</magicDamage> magic damage to enemies within @CleaveHexRange@ hex.
ability.name: Punish the Unworthy

ability.desc: For the next @BuffDuration@ seconds, gain <TFTBonus>@ModifiedAttackSpeed@</TFTBonus> Attack Speed, infinite range, and replace attacks with lasers. Lasers deal <physicalDamage>@ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleAP%)</physicalDamage> physical damage in a line, reduced by @DamageReductionPerEnemyHit*100@% for each enemy they pass through. When lasers critically strike, they deal <trueDamage>@BonusCritDamage*100@%</trueDamage> bonus true damage.
ability.name: Transcendent State

ability.desc:
Passive: Each second, restore @TotalHealing@ (%i:scaleHealth%%i:scaleAP%) Health and deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAP%) magic damage to enemies within 1 Hex.

{{TFT_Keyword_Chill}}

After charging, force nearby enemies to target this unit.
